folds.heading: ## Later root and procedure content reconciled, 2026-11-04 (B79)
folds.body: The root palette’s “Lane returns C6 and C8” already folds OM1–OM13’s ownership split and F1–F18/G1–G3, and its later C11–C16 return routes the completed [tension procedures](TENSION_DEFAULTS.md#g1-g3-short-procedures-with-world-dials). G1–G3 therefore no longer mean absent design procedures: the actual later text provides evidence/transmission-based quarantine, care-preserving competing-grant resolution, and communication/agency/standing-term review when a pet becomes sapient. Their source/world dials and GA1–GA5 scopes remain proposed, not implemented or canon-qualified wholesale. Missing selected execution remains distinct from missing design. Preserve support/obedience/regard, body/controller, custody/title, surviving actor/new heir edge and accessible memory/durable history distinctions. Root running-lane statements are dated history. The one-realm milestone and 1366 viewport are retired; current desktop authority and AD36/AD42/AD43 govern selected delivery, with optional human review. Original IDs, aliases and compatible variants stay; no duplicate pet registry, new acceptance question, worker dispatch or runtime slice follows (AD32).

folds.heading: ## Companion map and G1–G3 follow-through, 2026-11-04 (B79)
folds.body: The [C6 map reconciliation](gm/dispatch/companions-2026-10-14/OWNER_MAP.md#later-root-and-procedure-content-reconciled-2026-11-04-b79) verifies the existing root fold and actual later C11 procedure text. G1–G3 have proposed design treatment; selection and demonstrated execution remain open. G1 distinguishes suspected exposure from infection and actual transmission/care/reunion; G2 preserves necessary support while incompatible grants are resolved; G3 separates observed communication, mind/agency, local rights and reviewed permissions, retaining history and care without treating old obedience as retrospective consent. Six world-type dials and GA1–GA5 keep local law, clock, body/control, custody, information and ending terms distinct. This note reads only that selected C11 section, not all of its world fits or every nonhuman/source owner. No hunger death, automatic away aging, universal grief wound, new pet schema or mandatory director gate is added (AD32/AD36/AD42).
